points.text: Experiments only compare SOGD with OGD; adaptive or meta-learning baselines missing.
Bounds' constants and assumptions limit practicality; high computational cost in large-scale settings.
DNP-cu seems unnecessary; any combiner may work; Figure 1 mismatch problem overstated.
Exponential step-size grids and iterative expert combination are established; limited novelty.
Practical motivation for unknown lambda problem not concrete.
No extension to time-varying lambda despite motivation of changing preferences.
Missing discussion of OCO with unbounded memory (discounted infinite memory) line of work.
Algorithm 3 hard to read; equations should be inline.
Differences from Zhang et al. (2022), which uses same algorithm, insufficiently discussed.
Theorem 3 may follow from strongly adaptive regret via short Abel-summation reduction; unaddressed.
Novelty language overstated; each ingredient comes from prior work.
Gaps in Kapralov-Panigrahy sketch are never listed.
"Open question" attribution to Zhang et al. 2024 needs quotation; may differ.
Related work omits strongly adaptive reductions and parameter-free lines.
Relevance of Krichene et al. citation unexplained.
Theorem 3 possibly a corollary of strongly adaptive regret; open-question framing depends on it.
"Cost of adaptivity" asserted without lower bound.
Final step of Lemma 1 proof invalid.
Lemma 1 hypothesis U(n)>=20 not what proof needs.
Window restriction tau>=32 log T is vacuous and could be removed.
Known horizon T dependence is real but not discussed; no anytime variant.
Claimed gaps and inaccuracies in earlier sketch not enumerated.
No sanity experiment; constants may make bound vacuous for realistic T.
Two definitions of g and erf; Algorithm 1 unclear which.
"Uniformly over time" holds for OGD, not SOGD.
Notation typo (f vs gradient) and Jensen misnamed.
n>=tau/2 in (31) vs n=tau in U(n) bound inconsistent.
No experiment showing guarantee practically meaningful; unclear when bound beats trivial.
Oracle model and per-round computational cost (multiple gradient/function evaluations) unstated.
Method requires known horizon; real streams have none.
Bounded domain and gradient assumptions needed; unknown D or G not discussed.
Links to adaptive filtering, discounted bandits and EMA optimizers not drawn.
Fixed comparator only partly captures drift; dynamic regret comparison missing.
Lemma 1 proof contains invalid inequality step in n.
Key inequalities imported from prior papers, contradicting "complete analysis" framing.
Cost of adaptivity and tightness asserted without lower bound.
No numerical sanity check of whether bound is informative.
Method not anytime; grid uses horizon T.
Window restriction removable; extension to all lambda should be stated.
Lemma 1 assumes U(n)>=20 but proof needs 22.
n>=tau/2 vs n=tau inconsistency in Section 4.3.
Typos: gradient notation, Jensen misnamed, duplicated phrase.
g and erf defined twice with different normalisations.
Lemma 2 coefficients do not sum to 1 for finite T.
Claim that prior sketch had gaps is unsupported.
No limitations section.
Hard to tell what is new; no contribution list; novelty wording overstated.
No discussion of tightness or expected lower bound.
No limitations or practical meaning discussion.
Two error-function and g definitions.
Figure captions too short.
Typos.

P.summary: Experiments compare only against OGD; adaptive baselines missing.
Practicality and computational cost of method in large-scale settings.
Necessity of DNP-cu and severity of mismatch problem questioned.
Limited novelty: techniques established in prior work.
Practical motivation for unknown lambda weak.
Missing related work on OCO with unbounded memory.
Differences from Zhang et al. 2022 unclear.

Q.summary: Main theorem may be corollary of strongly adaptive regret reduction.
Novelty overstated; delta from prior work unclear.
Claimed gaps in prior sketch not enumerated.
Related work omits strongly adaptive and parameter-free lines.
Cost of adaptivity/tightness asserted without lower bound.
Window restriction unnecessary; extension not stated.
No experiments or sanity check of practical meaning.
Uniform-over-time remark applies to OGD only.
Per-round computational and oracle cost unstated.
